tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Pure black. Ink in Day, ground in Night. Never tinted.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Pure white. Ground in Day, ink in Night.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page ground. Text on it: `ink` and `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Panels, wells and table stripes sitting on `surface-100`. Text on it: `ink` and `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface-100`, `surface-200` and `field`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, taglines and labels on `surface-100` and `surface-200`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders and rules around controls and panels (3:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet dividers inside panels and receipt rules (3:1 or better on `surface-100` and `surface-200`).

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Solid fills: primary buttons, title cards, awning stripes, selected state. Text on it: `on-fill`.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `fill`.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Input background. Typed text is `ink`; its border is `line`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: a solid 3px outline, offset 3px, on `surface-100` and `surface-200`.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The wordmark and hero name. Italic, all caps.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section openers and the tagline at poster size. Italic, sentence case.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Panel and card titles. Roman, sentence case.

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: A database, a login, a brain

styles.name: subhead
styles.sample: One script tag and you are open

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Hand us a page. We get it done.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Your data stays yours until you say otherwise.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, buttons and chips. All caps, widely tracked.

tokens.name: space-1

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; inset of an arch window.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding, button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; awning stripe width on the cover.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section gaps on a page.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page margins and hero spacing.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything by default: buttons, inputs, panels, title cards. Square shopfront edges.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The status chip, and the top corners of an Arch (`radius-pill radius-pill 0 0`).

tokens.name: shadow-hard
tokens.usage: Sign-painter drop shadow on raised panels and hovered buttons: a hard offset in the ink color, no blur.

tokens.name: shadow-hard-sm
tokens.usage: The same drop shadow, smaller, for buttons and chips at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-frame
tokens.usage: Double-rule frame: a 1px line 3px outside a component border, the way a shop window is lettered.

tokens.name: border-thick
tokens.usage: Controls, panels and title cards.

tokens.name: border-thin
tokens.usage: Rules inside a panel and receipt lines.
